fit_faces.method: independent Owen-scrambled two-dimensional Sobol design on each of six faces

validation.method: independent Owen-scrambled Sobol in three dimensions

test.method: independent Owen-scrambled Sobol in three dimensions

paths.parameterization: straight segment from the reference; the shared reference is not scored

mesh_policy.audit_selection: 16 maximin points from fit volume, validation, and test; eight corners plus eight maximin face points
mesh_policy.cold_start_selection: eight maximin points from each of fit volume, validation, and test

solver_policy.failed_increment_action: restore the last converged state and halve the increment
solver_policy.failed_target_action: retain the requested state and failure record; do not replace or resample it
solver_policy.training_gate: all requested fit, validation, test and path endpoints must be available before training

excluded_on_B.Regression: Material A remains the direct-stress/integrability witness; repeating it on B does not answer the fixed-versus-learned feature question.

models.fixed_feature_rule: Select one shared admissible 32-feature table by the frozen NNLS plus reference-tangent plus fit-only pivoted-QR rule; use no validation, test, or path labels.
models.learned_feature_rule: Initialize from that same table and train directions and admissible exponents; the fixed counterpart keeps the table unchanged.
models.selection: minimum validation stress objective within each run; test and path sets remain unopened until every checkpoint is locked
models.reporting: report every seed and mean plus standard deviation; use the median-validation seed for curves, never the best test seed
models.controlled_claim: Fixed versus learned is controlled within each core. Free versus constrained cores and ICNN versus ICKAN are not parameter-count-matched ablations.

metrics.components: componentwise RMSE normalized by fit-set RMS; all scale floors are fixed from fit only

scope: Material B is constitutive-only: no POD, HPROM, MAW-ECM or second FE2 deployment. This protocol assesses interpolation and declared boundary paths, not extrapolation, contact, equilibrium uniqueness or complete stability of the RVE.
